evidence.observed: import sqlite3 and SQLite DDL in production implementation

payload.reason: R4-D1-002 used SQLite as the production cursor and revision store despite the PostgreSQL-authoritative R4 contract

evidence.observed: no persist_pit_snapshot function or database transaction in pit_snapshot.py
evidence.required: append-only PostgreSQL snapshot and label persistence with disposable-DB tests

payload.reason: R4-D1-005 created an in-memory snapshot and PostgreSQL DDL but did not implement or test the transactional PostgreSQL materialization path

evidence.required: new content hash, new PIT proofs, and PostgreSQL-persisted R4 snapshot

payload.reason: R4-D1-006 trusted legacy V7 READY summaries without rematerializing the real evidence through the new R4 XNAS cutoff, feature provenance, and release-native feature path

evidence.required: all 7,712 feature rows and mature labels, per-feature revision provenance table with zero PIT violations, versioned XNAS calendar hash and early-close checks

payload.reason: R4-D1-006 hard-coded provenance success, used 16:00 for every session including early closes, materialized zero labels, and inferred release-native status from feature names

Latest D1-006 acceptance overstated full multivariate PIT readiness: the persisted active snapshot has only one M2 feature per origin; provenance lacks source revision identifiers, transformation hashes, and data grade; blanket masking leaves target/core market features unusable; release-native coverage is not the required 11-series feature set.

evidence.required_input: origin+horizon exact E0 empirical sample vectors generated under the frozen E0 algorithm

payload.reason: V2-002 acceptance used 1,021 h21 score rows as if they were E0 empirical distribution samples. The review pack contains aggregate/row scores but no origin-level E0 path sample matrix, so an exact comparator sample identity and E0-only CRPS replay were not demonstrated.

Exact E0 sample matrices are generated model artifacts, not missing external data. The authoritative R4 PIT snapshot already contains 7,712 NASDAQ price origins and 30,758 mature horizon labels, so the frozen E0 historical/block-bootstrap generator must create and persist origin+horizon vectors locally.

evidence.required_behavior: exact matured direct-horizon training-label empirical vector for each frozen evaluation origin+horizon; no RNG or quantile/Gaussian reconstruction

payload.reason: V2-002 changed the frozen comparator from candidates.E0.algorithm=exact_empirical_anchor to a newly invented historical moving-block bootstrap and generated only four latest coordinates. Comparator, evaluation window, horizons, and weekly origin grid are frozen and may not be redefined.

required: rejected artifact quarantined or marked unusable

payload.reason: V2-002 exact empirical core passed, but the previously integrated generate_e0_samples_v7_r4.py still imports removed block-bootstrap symbols and exits ImportError; its four-coordinate block-bootstrap artifact remains under the active generated/e0_sample_matrices path. Acceptance requires a non-broken exact-anchor tool and explicit quarantine of the rejected comparator artifact.

evidence.required_complexity: precompute cross absolute-distance terms in O(N log N) per pair; O(model_count^2) per objective
evidence.required_no_regret: if optimized mixture CRPS >= E0 CRPS - tolerance, return weights exactly (1,0,...)

payload.reason: V2-003 computes cross-model E|X_i-X_j| by materializing an N-by-N broadcast matrix inside every SLSQP objective call and does not compare the optimized final mixture CRPS back to E0 before returning. This is not operationally usable for exact empirical anchors with thousands of labels across the frozen weekly grid and does not fully enforce no-regret fallback.

detected_defects: source is nested predecessor review pack
baseline_crps is copied rather than recomputed from exact E0 samples
not bound to R4 five-role validation

payload.reason: The accepted artifact reused 4,082 predecessor V7 score rows and their legacy baseline_crps instead of replaying the frozen exact empirical E0 comparator from the R4 rematerialized PostgreSQL PIT snapshot and matured direct-horizon labels over the full weekly origin grid.

The exact E0 replay changed the frozen weekly evaluation grid by selecting Friday-only sessions and omitted all 35 holiday-shortened weeks. The immutable predecessor grid has 1,025 weekly origins and 4,082 horizon coordinates, including Thursday origins when Friday was closed; the accepted artifact used 990 origins and 3,944 coordinates.

detected_defects: horizon CRPS absent from optimization objective
stability penalty absent from optimization objective
np.array_split held-out complements train on future observations
evidence.required_objective: Student-t NLL + horizon CRPS + stability penalty

payload.reason: The accepted E2 implementation optimized only in-sample Student-t NLL. The frozen R4 preregistration requires Student-t NLL plus horizon CRPS plus a stability penalty, and its cross-fitted scale residuals must be produced by temporal folds without training on observations after a held-out row. The implementation used ordinary K-fold complements that include future rows.

The accepted G1 funnel did not execute E1-E4. It consumed one predecessor V7 legacy candidate and precomputed 4,082-row model_crps/baseline_crps summaries, so it neither screened the implemented R4 core families nor used R4 model score rows. M3-008 owns the sealed outer qualification and must remain unexposed.

evidence.required_score: distribution CRPS from stored predictive distribution
evidence.score_implementation: mean absolute error of p50/location forecasts

payload.reason: G1 attempt mislabeled point MAE as distribution CRPS, asserted five-role proof without a role receipt, and changed frozen E1/E2/E3 candidate and optimizer coordinates during acceptance.
